pathResults.1_viteConfig: apps/web/vite.config.ts runs execFileSync(process.execPath, [<config dir>/scripts/node-certificate-validator.mjs, '--write'], {cwd: <config dir>, stdio: 'inherit'}) at module top level, before defineConfig. Vite evaluates this config before it creates the dev server, build or preview, and Vitest uses it too (apps/web has no vitest config). Every main-config start therefore runs the same reviewed generator, including the launcher's node vite.js (no --config; Vite auto-loads vite.config.ts from cwd apps/web) and the npm dev/build/test callers. A non-zero generator exit throws during config load, so Vite exits before it listens; the launcher then gets no listener rather than a ready-but-broken page. The output bytes are identical to the npm-hook output (same generator, same deterministic content). Only these 7 lines changed. pathResults.2_directLaunchProof: tools/verify_vite_direct_launch.py requires hosted Linux, a clean tracked tree, both outputs untracked and both absent before it starts, and deletes nothing (deletedFiles []). It starts the actual node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config vite.config.ts on a fresh loopback port with --strictPort in a new session, with no npm. After transport readiness it requires that both outputs now exist and that the child is still alive. It checks the manifest format esm and selfContained, and checks the schema, lock, generator and validator hashes against the files on disk. Then real sandboxed Chrome must show the login heading and button with a non-empty #root, and the validator module must return 200. Page errors, request failures, non-GET methods, and any HTTP error other than an exact /favicon.svg 404 fail the run. It signals only its own process group and waits. Causal coverage: because nothing else generates before this step, the outputs it observes can only come from the main config. On cc607 the same script would fail at 'Config did not generate both outputs before readiness', matching Root's PC3 reproduction of cc607 (index 200, module 500, generated ESM absent before and after).
